g.text: UC06 - immutable result membership and cursor (REVIEW)
queryRequestId, X,Y, packageIds, OR/AND, includeFee, pageSize
existing fixed query or new claim; different filters conflict
reuse original membership, totals and cutoff
get or persist original cutoff, preserve on retry
one consistent source selection by recordedAt in [X,Y)
persist fixed members + derived subscriber totals atomically
next members, no live membership changes
reject / request new query, never substitute live result
recordedAt is business timestamp in ultimately committed tx.
It is not physical COMMIT completion time.
Page processing never holds an open DB transaction while user reads.
OR: any selected package; AND: every selected package per subscriber.
